changeSet.author: cmr
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE cmr_search_history ADD COLUMN operator_id BIGINT COMMENT '操作人' AFTER user_id, ADD COLUMN operator_name VARCHAR(64) COMMENT '操作人显示名', ADD COLUMN strategy_no VARCHAR(32) COMMENT '策略业务编号 STG', ADD COLUMN strategy_version INT COMMENT '策略版本号', ADD COLUMN threshold DECIMAL(4,2) COMMENT '本次相似度阈值', ADD COLUMN sealed CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'T' COMMENT '本次运行是否封存（历史记录默认封存）', ADD COLUMN replay_of_task_no VARCHAR(32) COMMENT '重放自原任务号', ADD COLUMN eval_id BIGINT COMMENT '归属评测 id', ADD COLUMN summary_expire_time DATETIME COMMENT 'Top-20 摘要过期时间（30 天）';

changeSet.author: cmr
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE cmr_result_item ADD COLUMN item_name VARCHAR(512) COMMENT '条目名称快照' AFTER item_id, ADD COLUMN source VARCHAR(256) COMMENT '来源名快照' AFTER modality, ADD COLUMN align_score DECIMAL(10,6) COMMENT '对齐分（算子返回时）' AFTER score;

changeSet.author: cmr
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE cmr_item_vote ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '雪花主键', task_no VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT '任务号', search_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '检索历史 id', item_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '条目 ID', vote VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL COMMENT 'up/down', user_id BIGINT COMMENT '评价人', create_id BIGINT, create_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_id BIGINT, update_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, del_flag CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'F', UNIQUE KEY uk_vote (task_no, item_id, user_id), KEY idx_search (search_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='cmr 单条赞踩';

changeSet.author: cmr
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE cmr_favorite ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '雪花主键', user_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '收藏人', item_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '条目 ID', item_name VARCHAR(512) COMMENT '条目名称', source VARCHAR(256) COMMENT '来源名', task_no VARCHAR(32) COMMENT '来源任务号', create_id BIGINT, create_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_id BIGINT, update_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, del_flag CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'F', UNIQUE KEY uk_user_item (user_id, item_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='cmr 收藏';
